methods.title: Payment and refund methods
methods.description: Methods staff and integrations may record. Names come from the strings (`ledger.method.<key>`) unless `label` is set; `requires_reference` refuses entries without a reference (bank or receipt number).

allow_partial_refunds.title: Allow partial refunds
allow_partial_refunds.description: Off: a refund must return everything still held.

allow_overpayment.title: Accept payments above the order total

refunded_status.title: Status of a fully refunded order
refunded_status.description: Recording the last refund moves the order here when the matrix allows it (empty = never move).
